reviews.title: Product excellent Amazon's packaging and shipping very poor
reviews.comment: The motherboard is excellent, but Amazon is really starting to upset and anger me due to the way they handle shipping recently, it is VERY far from acceptable to simply slap a shipping label on the manufacturers packaging and ship it on something as fragile as this, not to mention they put those labels right over desired information you will want about the product in the box, this has happened more  than once now and I have had enough I am canceling my Amazon prrime because of it, and will in the future do much less of any purchasing I do from Amazon, Amazon used to be good but of recent they seem to only care about profit and little else. Edit,,, have had this board up and going in my system for about a month now and have put it thru it's paces having done numerous test/stress testing such as prime95, Cinebench, silverbench extreem testing and benchmarking, Geekbench benchmarking, And so on,, I even let it run on prime95 for a full hour back to back with 3 runs thru silverbench's "extreem" stress test that has actuall warnings about possible damage to components because of how extreem the test is and it passed without breaking a sweat with good scores for performance,,, just so potential buyers know my full system is this mother board a 12th gen i7 12700kf cpu, Asus tough gaming 4070ti super oc og edition GPU, 1tb WD sn850x heat sink M.2 main drive, 2tb WD sn850x heat sink M.2, 32gb corsair vengence 5600 ram with 36-36-36 timing in dual channel, noctua NH-15D gen 2 tower cooler, Corsair rm1000e PSU, It is all built in the Montech king 95 pro case using the mesh front with 4 case fans at 140mm for intake air 2 in the front 2 from the side, also 3-120mm intake ones from the bottom as the case comes, one 120mm exaust as the case comes, and two 140mm fans for exaust out the top, 10 case fans in all but they are nearly dead silent even when doing all that heavy stress testing and temps stayed plenty cool,,, the GPU never saw a temp above 65 degrees C even when running the heaviest GPU test I could, the CPU only had a couple cores get to about 82 to 85 degrees at the hottest under the heaviest stress testing then it was for less than a second or two and right back down to less than 80 and package temps never got over 80 degrees C,,,, more like high 70's,,,, This is a ROCK solid board with everything you need and nothing you don't to waste your money on, unless you need more usb's or some other ports, or feel you just have to have on board graphics save your money and rest assured this will do you very very well.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Another great MSI motherboard!!!
reviews.comment: The MSI PRO B760-VC WIFI IV has been a game-changer for my PC setup. Its performance is outstanding—I can seamlessly switch between gaming and work tasks without any lag. The build quality is impressive; it feels robust and looks sleek in my setup. I particularly appreciate the effortless connectivity with WiFi 6E and Bluetooth 5.2, along with the future-proof PCIe 4.0 support. Setting it up was a breeze, and customizing the RGB lighting added a fun, personal touch. Overall, it’s not just a motherboard but a reliable companion that has significantly enhanced my computing experience.
reviews.author: Kenny K

reviews.title: USB Hardware power inadequate for gaming.
reviews.comment:
Don't buy this if you are a gamer. The USB hubs built in to the motherboard are not given enough power, and during a game demanding hardware power to USB (That's like, all of them) USB devices will randomly disconnect. This is, to say the least, troublesome when you have a USB KB/Mouse/Headset (even wireless).
It makes a great workstation, but it's a total waste of money when trying to build a gaming system.
reviews.author: Paul

reviews.title: It's fine for a budget board, but understand the limitations
reviews.comment:
The board looks nice, has decent features, but be aware of these limitations:
1) If you take advantage of the WiFi feature, you will lose the 2nd M2 slot, since the wifi module uses that slot
2) If you use the 2nd M2 slot for a SATA drive rather than an NVME drive, you lose SATA connecter 8 on the mother board
3) There is no video port (typically HDMI) on this board, so it requires a separate video card
4) Amazon's description of maximum memory is incorrect (64GB).  It's actually 192GB
5) On all MSI B760 boards, the connectors for HDD LED, Reset, Power, and Power LED are in a tiny corner all together which makes it miserable to get these connectors once it's placed in the case
If you can live with these limitations, it's a fine board, and apparently all MSI boards are on sale now, so it's a great time to buy.
reviews.author: TomK1
